name: Cell Biology, Stem Cells, and Development (CSD) PhD
institution: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

sources.label: BSP explanation of program entry and rotation options

detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without an entry year; not confirmed for Fall 2027.

publishedDeadlines.label: International priority deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without a year. Applications between November 1 and December 1 are considered only when all components are received and processed.

applicationFee.note: $50 domestic; $75 international. Graduate School fee waivers are offered for qualifying applicants. International applicants should confirm eligibility. Request at least one week before the final deadline.

documents: Transcripts from all colleges and universities attended

english.note: International Admissions university minimums may be superseded by program requirements. The linked central table also lists TOEFL section minima; confirm current score-scale and exemption requirements with the program.

international.note: International students may apply with the understanding that they will obtain the required sponsored student visa. Confirm work-authorization and funding eligibility with the program.

funding.note: Accepted PhD students receive full tuition, health and dental insurance, and a published stipend of $43,000 per year. The page gives no academic year. Continued support depends on satisfactory academic and research performance; the thesis mentor assumes support after lab entry.
